e2generator.sky.presets.title: Sky & Environment Presets
e2generator.sky.reset.tooltip: Restore sun/moon tilt, texture scales and compatibility options to their defaults.
e2generator.sky.preset.save.tooltip: Save the current settings into this slot (overwrites its contents).
e2generator.sky.preset.load.tooltip: Load the settings stored in this slot.
e2generator.configuration.title: AIGC`s Equal Earth Generator
e2generator.worldgen.title: World Generation Controller
e2generator.worldgen.seed.tooltip: World seed. Leave it empty and a random seed is filled in on every refresh.
e2generator.worldgen.radius.tooltip:
Planet radius in chunks (allowed: %s ~ %s).
The radius fixes the size of the sphere; its surface is then projected onto the plane with the Equal Earth equal-area projection to compute the actual world size.
e2generator.worldgen.polar.tooltip:
When enabled, continents may reach the pole line.
When disabled, an ocean buffer is kept around the poles.
e2generator.worldgen.cross_boundary.tool:
When enabled, continents may touch the east/west seam.
When disabled, an ocean buffer hides the seam.
e2generator.worldgen.refresh.tooltip:
Recompute the planet size ruler.
An empty seed field is filled with a random seed.
e2generator.worldgen.apply.tooltip: Apply the seed and planet settings to the world that is about to be created.
e2generator.worldgen.cancel.tooltip: Go back without applying any changes.
e2generator.worldgen.preview.tooltip:
Planet size ruler: the leaf shape is the Equal Earth map outline, the ruler below shows the world width in chunks.
Map area equals sphere area (equal-area projection).
